issues.description: The spec's review words 'room' and 'house' are never used in the dialogue, so the recycling opportunity the spec calls for is missed. The target word 'rent' is well covered.
issues.suggested_fix: Work one review word into Ben's reply, e.g. 'Yes, I've just come from there. The rooms are big.' — this keeps the clip within the 10-15 second limit.

qa_report.summary: A clean micro-dialogue at A2. All four lines are grammatically correct and natural British English ('I've just come from there' is idiomatic BrE for having just been somewhere). The grammar point — present perfect with 'just' and 'already' — is used correctly in both lines, and the two grammar notes state accurate, level-appropriate rules. The gloss for 'rent' is precise and written in simpler English than the target word. All vocabulary is A1-A2. The only gap is that neither review word ('room', 'house') appears; this is a minor spec-coverage point, not an error, so the script is approved as is.
